problem: After PR #5097 protected merge, native Supabase deployment of powerhouse-seo-opportunity-resolver rejected index.ts with Expected comma / ExpectedUnicodeEscape near the daily-status filter.
root_cause: A literal backslash+n character pair was inserted as source text between chained PostgREST calls; source-only contract regex tests did not parse Deno TypeScript and falsely passed.

evidence.failed_release: Edge function bundle parser rejected literal escaped newline at index.ts line 102

fix: Replace exactly one escaped two-character backslash-n with an actual line break and add an explicit negative regression asserting the failure fingerprint is absent and the real newline is present.
prevention_rule: Every Edge Function mutation must pass syntax/bundle verification in addition to source-regex tests before publication. A failed deploy must retain the prior working provider version; never call release green without exact-main provider source parity.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required/BRAIN/CodeQL green, protected merge, authorized native Supabase production version upgrade, provider three-file parity and actual authenticated 200 canary. No additional scheduler or publisher.
